audience: Portuguese businesses that keep invoices, contacts and stock in Bill.pt

useCases.title: Look up the invoices of a customer
useCases.text: List sales documents, such as invoices and receipts, filtered by type, contact or number. These tools never create or change a document.

useCases.title: Find a customer and their payment terms
useCases.text: List customers and suppliers with their tax numbers, addresses and payment terms. Use the list to check a record before you invoice.

useCases.title: Add a new customer to the account
useCases.text: Create a customer or supplier in Bill.pt. The code must be unique in the account, and the record is saved at once.

useCases.title: Check stock levels per store
useCases.text: List the stores and the items, then read the stock level of each item per store at a date.

useCases.title: Find the ids for document types, VAT and series
useCases.text: List document types, VAT rates, numbering series and payment methods, with their ids. Use these ids in other tools.
